actions.apify_abort_actor_run.descriptio: Stops a running Actor run by run ID.
actions.apify_abort_actor_run.props.grac: If true, send a graceful abort so the actor can finish its current cycle and persist state before stopping. If false, the run is killed immediately.
actions.apify_abort_actor_run.props.runI: The ID of the run to abort. Obtain it from Run Actor or List Actor Runs.
actions.apify_create_task.description: Creates a new saved Actor task.
The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor this task wraps. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.
actions.apify_create_task.props.input.de: The JSON input body to store on the task. Match the Actor's input schema (see Get Actor Input Schema).
actions.apify_create_task.props.name.des: Unique name for the task (within your account). Creation fails if the name is already taken.
actions.apify_find_actor.description: Searches the public Apify Store for Actors by name or keyword.
actions.apify_find_actor.props.limit.des: Maximum number of actors to return. Default 50.
actions.apify_find_actor.props.offset.de: Number of actors to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_find_actor.props.search.de: Name or keyword to search the Apify Store for (e.g. "instagram scraper"). Leave empty to list popular store actors.
actions.apify_get_account.description: Retrieves the authenticated Apify account profile.
actions.apify_get_account_limits.descrip: Retrieves the authenticated account's plan limits and current usage.
actions.apify_get_actor.description: Retrieves metadata for a single Apify Actor by ID.
actions.apify_get_actor.props.actorId.de: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.
actions.apify_get_actor_input_schema.des: Retrieves the input schema (fields, types, required, enums) of an Actor's default build.
actions.apify_get_actor_input_schema.pro: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.
actions.apify_get_actor_last_run_dataset: Retrieves the dataset items of an Actor's most recent run by actor ID.
Get Actor Last Run Dataset Items
The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.
Maximum number of items to return. Must be greater than 0.
Number of items to skip at the start. Default 0.
Optionally restrict to the last run with this status (e.g. SUCCEEDED).
actions.apify_get_actor_run.description: Retrieves the status and details of an Actor run by run ID.
The ID of the run to read. Obtain it from Run Actor, List Actor Runs, or Get Last Actor Run.
actions.apify_get_actor_run.props.waitFo: Optional. Block server-side up to this many seconds (max 60) waiting for the run to reach a terminal state before returning. Leave empty for an immediate status read.
actions.apify_get_build.description: Retrieves the status and metadata of an Actor build by build ID.
actions.apify_get_build.props.buildId.de: The ID of the build to read. Obtain it from an actor's build list or a run's buildId.
actions.apify_get_build.props.waitForFin: Optional. Block server-side up to this many seconds (max 60) waiting for the build to finish before returning. Leave empty for an immediate status read.
actions.apify_get_dataset.description: Retrieves metadata for an Apify dataset by dataset ID.
actions.apify_get_dataset.props.datasetI: The ID of the dataset. Obtain it from List Datasets or a run's defaultDatasetId (Get Actor Run).
actions.apify_get_dataset_items.descript: Retrieves stored result items from an Apify dataset by dataset ID.
actions.apify_get_dataset_items.props.da: The ID of the dataset to read. Obtain it from a run's defaultDatasetId (Get Actor Run) or from List Datasets.
actions.apify_get_dataset_items.props.li: Maximum number of items to return. Must be greater than 0.
actions.apify_get_dataset_items.props.of: Number of items to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_get_key_value_store.descri: Retrieves metadata for an Apify key-value store by store ID.
The ID of the key-value store. Obtain it from List Key-Value Stores or a run's defaultKeyValueStoreId.
actions.apify_get_key_value_store_record: Retrieves a single record from an Apify key-value store by store ID and key.
The key of the record to retrieve (e.g. "OUTPUT"). Obtain available keys from List Key-Value Store Keys.
The ID of the key-value store. Obtain it from List Key-Value Stores or a run's defaultKeyValueStoreId (Get Actor Run).
actions.apify_get_last_actor_run.descrip: Retrieves the most recent run of an Actor, optionally filtered by status.
actions.apify_get_last_actor_run.props.a: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.
actions.apify_get_last_actor_run.props.s: Optionally restrict to the last run with this status.
actions.apify_get_run_dataset_items.desc: Retrieves the dataset items of an Actor run directly by run ID.
actions.apify_get_run_dataset_items.prop: Maximum number of items to return. Must be greater than 0.
Number of items to skip at the start. Default 0.
The ID of the run whose dataset items to read. Obtain it from Run Actor, List Actor Runs, or Get Last Actor Run.
actions.apify_get_run_log.description: Retrieves the plain-text log of an Actor run or build by ID.
actions.apify_get_run_log.props.runId.de: The run ID (from Run Actor / List Actor Runs) or build ID (from Get Build) whose log to fetch.
actions.apify_get_task.description: Retrieves metadata for a saved Actor task by task ID.
actions.apify_get_task.props.taskId.desc: The ID of the saved task. Obtain it from List Tasks.
actions.apify_get_task_input.description: Retrieves the stored input body of a saved Actor task by task ID.
actions.apify_get_task_input.props.taskI: The ID of the saved task. Obtain it from List Tasks.
actions.apify_get_task_last_run.descript: Retrieves the most recent run of a saved Actor task, optionally filtered by status.
actions.apify_get_task_last_run.props.st: Optionally restrict to the last run with this status.
actions.apify_get_task_last_run.props.ta: The ID of the saved task. Obtain it from List Tasks.
actions.apify_get_task_last_run_dataset_: Retrieves the dataset items of a task's most recent run by task ID.
Get Task Last Run Dataset Items
Maximum number of items to return. Must be greater than 0.
Number of items to skip at the start. Default 0.
Optionally restrict to the last run with this status (e.g. SUCCEEDED).
The ID of the saved task. Obtain it from List Tasks.
actions.apify_list_actor_runs.descriptio: Lists the run history of a single Actor.
actions.apify_list_actor_runs.props.acto: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor. Obtain it from Find Actor or List Actors.
actions.apify_list_actor_runs.props.limi: Maximum number of runs to return. Default 50.
actions.apify_list_actor_runs.props.offs: Number of runs to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_list_actors.description: Lists the Actors owned by the authenticated account.
actions.apify_list_actors.props.limit.de: Maximum number of actors to return. Default 50.
actions.apify_list_actors.props.offset.d: Number of actors to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_list_datasets.description: Lists the datasets in the authenticated account.
Maximum number of datasets to return. Default 50.
actions.apify_list_datasets.props.offset: Number of datasets to skip at the start. Default 0.
Lists the record keys in an Apify key-value store.
Maximum number of keys to return.
Optional. Only return keys starting with this prefix.
The ID of the key-value store. Obtain it from List Key-Value Stores or a run's defaultKeyValueStoreId.
actions.apify_list_key_value_stores.desc: Lists the key-value stores in the authenticated account.
actions.apify_list_key_value_stores.prop: Maximum number of stores to return. Default 50.
Number of stores to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_list_runs.description: Lists Actor runs across the whole account.
actions.apify_list_runs.props.limit.desc: Maximum number of runs to return. Default 50.
actions.apify_list_runs.props.offset.des: Number of runs to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_list_tasks.description: Lists the saved Actor tasks in the authenticated account.
actions.apify_list_tasks.props.limit.des: Maximum number of tasks to return. Default 50.
actions.apify_list_tasks.props.offset.de: Number of tasks to skip at the start. Default 0.
actions.apify_run_actor.description: Starts an Apify Actor by ID and optionally waits for it to finish.
actions.apify_run_actor.props.actorId.de: The ID (or "username~actor-name") of the Actor to run. Obtain it from Find Actor (public Apify Store search) or List Actors (your account's own actors).
actions.apify_run_actor.props.build.desc: Build to run — a build tag or build number. Defaults to the build in the Actor's default run configuration (typically "latest").
actions.apify_run_actor.props.input.desc: JSON input body for the run. Get the field names/types/required from Get Actor Input Schema for this actor. If omitted, the Actor uses the input from its default run configuration.
actions.apify_run_actor.props.memory.des: Memory limit for the run in megabytes (e.g. 256, 1024, 4096). Defaults to the Actor's default run configuration.
actions.apify_run_actor.props.timeout.de: Optional timeout for the run in seconds. Defaults to the Actor's default run configuration.
actions.apify_run_actor.props.waitForFin: If true, block until the run finishes (server-side, capped ~60s) and return its dataset items. For long runs leave false and poll with Get Actor Run.
actions.apify_run_task.description: Runs a saved Apify Actor task by ID and optionally waits for it to finish.
actions.apify_run_task.props.build.descr: Build to run — a build tag or build number. Defaults to the build in the task settings.
actions.apify_run_task.props.input.descr: Optional JSON to override the task's stored input for this run only. If omitted, the task runs with its saved input (see Get Task Input).
actions.apify_run_task.props.memory.desc: Memory limit for the run in megabytes. Defaults to the task settings.
actions.apify_run_task.props.taskId.desc: The ID of the saved task to run. Obtain it from List Tasks.
actions.apify_run_task.props.timeout.des: Optional timeout for the run in seconds. Defaults to the task settings.
actions.apify_run_task.props.waitForFini: If true, block until the run finishes (server-side, capped ~60s) and return its dataset items. For long runs leave false and poll with Get Actor Run.
actions.apify_scrape_url.description: Scrapes a single web page via the Apify Website Content Crawler and returns its markdown and HTML.
actions.apify_scrape_url.props.url.descr: The page URL to scrape. Must start with http:// or https://.
actions.apify_update_task_input.descript: Overwrites the stored input body of a saved Actor task by task ID.
actions.apify_update_task_input.props.in: The full JSON input body to store on the task. This replaces the existing input entirely. Match the Actor's input schema (see Get Actor Input Schema for the task's actor).
actions.apify_update_task_input.props.ta: The ID of the saved task to reconfigure. Obtain it from List Tasks.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
Select the dataset to get items from.
actions.getDatasetItems.props.limit.desc: Maximum number of items to return. Must be above 0.
actions.getDatasetItems.props.offset.des: Items to skip from the start.
actions.getKeyValueStoreRecord.descripti: Gets a record from a key-value store by its key.
actions.getKeyValueStoreRecord.props.rec: The key the record is saved under.
actions.getKeyValueStoreRecord.props.sto: The store that holds the record.
actions.runActor.description: Runs an Actor and, if you wait, returns its results.
actions.runActor.props.actorSource.descr: Your recently run Actors, or any public Actor in the Apify Store.
actions.runActor.props.build.description: Build tag or number to run. Empty: the default build.
actions.runActor.props.timeout.descripti: Seconds before the run is stopped. Empty: the Actor's default.
actions.runActor.props.waitForFinish.des: On: waits and returns the run's dataset items. Off: only starts it.
actions.runTask.description: Runs a saved Actor task and, if you wait, returns its results.
actions.runTask.props.build.description: Build tag or number to run. Empty: the default build.
actions.runTask.props.memory.description: Empty: the memory set in the task.
actions.runTask.props.taskid.description: A saved task from your Apify account.
actions.runTask.props.timeout.descriptio: Seconds before the run is stopped. Empty: the task's setting.
actions.runTask.props.waitForFinish.desc: On: waits and returns the run's dataset items. Off: only starts it.
actions.scrapeSingleUrl.description: Gets one page's content as Markdown and HTML using Apify.
actions.scrapeSingleUrl.props.crawlerTyp: Raw HTTP is fastest but skips JavaScript. Adaptive and Firefox render it; Firefox is blocked least.
actions.scrapeSingleUrl.props.url.descri: Must start with http:// or https://.
auth.props.apikey.description: Find your API key on Apify in the settings, API & Integrations section.
description: Access Apify tools for web scraping, data extraction, and automation.
triggers.watchActorRunsTrigger.descripti: Fires when a run of the Actor ends with a chosen status.
triggers.watchActorRunsTrigger.props.act: Your recently run Actors, or any public Actor in the Apify Store.
triggers.watchActorRunsTrigger.props.sta: Run outcomes that start the flow.
triggers.watchActorRunsTrigger.props.web: Turning this flow on creates a webhook in your Apify account. Turning it off removes it.
triggers.watchTaskRunsTrigger.descriptio: Fires when a run of the task ends with a chosen status.
triggers.watchTaskRunsTrigger.props.stat: Run outcomes that start the flow.
triggers.watchTaskRunsTrigger.props.task: A saved task from your Apify account.
triggers.watchTaskRunsTrigger.props.webh: Turning this flow on creates a webhook in your Apify account. Turning it off removes it.
